verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automatic receipt capture tied to card swipes, with memos and categories filled in and edits or submission possible via SMS, Slack or Teams. It also says receipts are captured and coded to the correct GL account, and the CLI exposes receipt upload/attach against transactions. However, nothing explicitly documents snapping a photo or forwarding an email for OCR-based matching to the right transaction. The 99% OCR claim refers to bill-pay invoices, not employee receipts. missing for 10: explicit photo-capture and email-forwarding channels, documented receipt OCR with automatic transaction matching, independent or hands-on corroboration.
